title: Validate rechargeFormula as a dice expression at spend time
description: spend_usage stores declared.rechargeFormula without checking it parses as dice notation (usageCounters.ts declared-economy validation only checks reset === dawn). restore_usage now refuses a non-dice or sub-1 formula when it tries to roll, but the bad economy is accepted at spend time and only fails later. Validate with parseDice/minimumDiceTotal at declaration. Found while implementing eshyra-lyzj (fa1551f9).
